设计意图： The primary mechanism comes from the payoff-supported tail-fragility parent: deep drawdowns accompanied by a high share of downside intraday tail energy indicate persistent stress. The sole transferred idea from the predictive-first parent is causal EWMA smoothing, applied only to the existing tail-energy estimator rather than adding its close-return semivariance signal. This replaces hard rolling

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply((-divide(⊗1, add(⊗1, ts_ema(power(divide(clip(subtract(AdjHigh, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), , 1), ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 2), 30)))), subtract(1, divide(AdjClose, ts_max(AdjClose, 60))))
  2. 2. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(⊗1, add(⊗1, ts_ema(power(divide(clip(subtract(AdjHigh, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), , 1), ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 2), 30)))
  3. 3. add —— 加法
    add(⊗1, ts_ema(power(divide(clip(subtract(AdjHigh, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), , 1), ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 2), 30))
  4. 4. ts_ema —— 指数移动平均
    ts_ema(power(divide(clip(subtract(AdjHigh, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), , 1), ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 2), 30)
  5. 5. power —— 取幂(乘方)
    power(divide(clip(subtract(AdjHigh, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), , 1), ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 2)
  6. 6. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(clip(subtract(AdjHigh, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), , 1), ts_delay(AdjClose, 1))
  7. 7. clip —— 裁剪到区间[下限,上限]
    clip(subtract(AdjHigh, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), , 1)
  8. 8. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(AdjHigh, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1))
  9. 9. ts_delay —— 滞后 N 天(取N天前值)
    ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)
  10. 10. ts_delay —— 滞后 N 天(取N天前值)
    ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)
  11. 11. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(1, divide(AdjClose, ts_max(AdjClose, 60)))
  12. 12. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(AdjClose, ts_max(AdjClose, 60))
  13. 13. ts_max —— 过去 N 天滚动最大值
    ts_max(AdjClose, 60)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 previous_close：close.shift(1)
  2. 计算 downside_tail：(previous_close - low).clip(lower=0.0) / previous_close
  3. 计算 upside_tail：(high - previous_close).clip(lower=0.0) / previous_close
  4. 计算 downside_energy：downside_tail.pow(2).ewm(span=30, min_periods=20, adjust=False).mean()
  5. 计算 upside_energy：upside_tail.pow(2).ewm(span=30, min_periods=20, adjust=False).mean()
  6. 计算 tail_asymmetry：downside_energy / (downside_energy + upside_energy)
  7. 计算 drawdown：1.0 - close / close.滚动窗口(60, min_periods=60).max()
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

  2. MA_30(downside excursion squared) — MA_30(downside excursion squared) — 用户自定义算子
  3. MA_30(upside prior-close-to-high excursion squared) — MA_30(upside prior-close-to-high excursion squared) — 用户自定义算子

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_tail_fragility_ewma_asymmetry(df): """Drawdown-conditioned downside tail-energy share with causal exponential smoothing.""" df_copy = df.copy() previous_close = df_copy["close"].shift(1) downside_tail = (previous_close - df_copy["low"]).clip(lower=0.0) / previous_close.replace(0.0, np.nan) upside_tail = (df_copy["high"] - previous_close).clip(lower=0.0) / previous_close.replace(0.0, np.nan) downside_energy = downside_tail.pow(2).ewm(span=30, min_periods=20, adjust="kw">class="kw">False).mean() upside_energy = upside_tail.pow(2).ewm(span=30, min_periods=20, adjust="kw">class="kw">False).mean() tail_asymmetry = downside_energy / (downside_energy + upside_energy).replace(0.0, np.nan) drawdown = 1.0 - df_copy["close"] / df_copy["close"].rolling(60, min_periods=60).max().replace(0.0, np.nan) df_copy["factor_tail_fragility_ewma_asymmetry"] = -tail_asymmetry * drawdown "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_tail_fragility_ewma_asymmetry"]
